claims.title: Order-five strongly endotactic geometry
claims.exact_statement: The five-reaction diagram 0→2A; 2A→3A+B; 3A+B→3A+2B; 3A+2B→3A; 3A+2B→2A is strongly endotactic and has maximum reactant source order 5.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Full essential-source directional convention, self arrows irrelevant, two species.
claims.scientific_importance: A legal small-order obstruction to deterministic-to-stochastic transfer; geometry is rate independent.
missing_obligations: External all-direction check or formal geometric certificate review.

claims.title: Exact all-state rate phase
claims.exact_statement: For d=k3+k4, beta=k2/d, q=k4/d, h(beta)=(1+beta exp(2beta)(2beta)^(-beta) gamma_lower(beta,2beta))/2 and mu=1-q h(beta), the minimal CTMC explodes almost surely from every finite state iff mu>0, and is nonexplosive from every finite state iff mu<=0.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Exactly C01 diagram; intensities k0, k1(a)_2, k2(a)_3 b, k3(a)_3(b)_2, k4(a)_3(b)_2; all constants fixed finite strictly positive.
claims.scientific_importance: Complete phase classification of a named-frontier low-order witness, including the critical boundary.
missing_obligations: External review of uniform full-event tails, occupation gamma and critical stopping/clock arguments.

claims.title: Two-species cubic regularity
claims.exact_statement: Every finite fully endotactic two-species stochastic mass-action network with maximum source total <=3 is nonexplosive from every finite state.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Arbitrary finite integral products, every fixed finite positive rate vector, active nontrivial sources; no irreducibility or stoichiometric-rank premise.
claims.scientific_importance: Universal dimension-specific lower theorem; complementary to the explicit order-five upper.
missing_obligations: External or formal review of complete piecewise/discrete Foster case proofs.

claims.title: Exact unresolved minimum intervals
claims.exact_statement: Two-species minimum explosive endotactic source order lies in {4,5}; minimum over arbitrary species counts lies in {3,4,5}.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: C01-C03 plus Xu order<=2 regularity; full endotacticity in every direction.
claims.scientific_importance: Narrows the open order question without claiming it solved.
missing_obligations: Order-four example or universal two-species order-four theorem; arbitrary-dimensional cubic exclusion remains unproved.

claims.title: Order-four near miss
claims.exact_statement: The displayed legal strong-endotactic order-four five-reaction near miss is nonexplosive for all its fixed positive rates via a+b+K/(b+1), K>4.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Only the exact diagram in the evidence file.
claims.scientific_importance: Preserves a mechanism failure; it is not a general lower bound.
missing_obligations: No promotion to all order-four networks.

claims.title: Collective concentration to centered Petz entropy
claims.exact_statement: For L=e(B+2)(d^2+1)/kappa, q=r/N, y=Lq/(1-q), chi_P^2<=A^2 y^2/(1-y) for 2<=r<N,y<1; for q<=1/(2L+1), chi_P^2,D<=8A^2 L^2 q^2. At r=1 both vanish.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Fixed d>=2; PI rho_N; actual tau_N>=kappa I; all Hermitian ||H||op<=1 and all real t satisfy centered collective MGF<=A exp(BNt^2), uniform constants. chi_P^2=Tr(rho_r^2 tau_N^(-tensor r))-1.
claims.scientific_importance: Strongest reusable structural principle, arbitrary faithful marginals and sector coherences.
missing_obligations: External proof review; acquisition of all-direction promise not supplied; growing dimension not covered.

claims.title: Quadratic order is sharp without entanglement
claims.exact_statement: For the equally weighted product mixture with eta_±=(I±diag(1,-1,0,...)/sqrt(N))/d, tau=I/d and chi_P^2=((1+2/(dN))^r+(1-2/(dN))^r)/2-1>=2r(r-1)/(d^2N^2).
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Fully separable PI family; A=1,B=1/2+2/d^2 satisfies all-direction MGF.
claims.scientific_importance: Shows structural quadratic rate is optimal; falsifies any generic entanglement inference.
missing_obligations: Universal sharp constant and relative-entropy constant not proved.

claims.title: Fixed-d Schur residual-tail sufficient condition
claims.exact_statement: For K=N-d lambda_d under Schur-Weyl weights, a uniform subGaussian K/sqrt(N) MGF implies chi_P^2,D=O_d((r/N)^2) relative to actual tau_N^tensor r for every r=o(N).
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Fixed d and fixed tail constants; PI state, arbitrary irrep density matrices/coherences; finite range and eventual faithful tau stated in proofs.
claims.scientific_importance: Representation-theoretic sufficient law extending beyond qubits.
missing_obligations: Growing-d result; matched qudit ALLSEP certification upper; external validation.

claims.title: Centered white-Schur qubit entropy
claims.exact_statement: Exact white Schur weights and arbitrary within-sector states imply chi_P^2,D=O((r/N)^2) through every sublinear r; r=1 is exactly zero.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Qubits, PI, exact maximally mixed sector weights; comparison is actual one-site product, not white reference.
claims.scientific_importance: Removes linear own-mean contribution and supports operational lower bounds.
missing_obligations: No mean-Casimir-only extension.

claims.title: Sharp white-law Petz minimax coefficient
claims.exact_statement: Supremum M(N,r) over Q04 class satisfies |M-3r(r-1)/N^2|<=42(r/N)^2/sqrt(N)+900000(r/N)^3 for N>=256,2<=r<=N/128. Fixed r gives N^2M→3r(r-1); growing r=o(N) gives M/(r/N)^2→3.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Full white-law tail required; +/- extremal-spin family is asymptotically extremizing, not exact finite optimizer.
claims.scientific_importance: Actual sharp strengthening; separate from big-O and operational constants.
missing_obligations: Exact finite optimizer; optimized remainder; sharp KL or testing constants.

claims.title: ALLSEP preparation lower bound
claims.exact_statement: For fixed testing bias against all fully separable N-qubit alternatives, access <=r distinct sites per fresh copy requires m=Omega(N^2/r^2) for r=o(N); r=1 cannot certify the target for any m. Deterministic budgets r_i imply sum r_i^2=Omega(N^2).
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Independent fresh preparations, classical adaptive labels and arbitrary joint accessed-system quantum processing; matching product tau^tensor N is a legal null; no Casimir promise on null.
claims.scientific_importance: Sound quantum lower bound under an explicit supplied-versus-acquired null contract.
missing_obligations: No adaptive expected-readout claim from a maximum cap; coherent global addressing or correlated preparations not covered.

claims.title: Finite three-axis uniform ALLSEP upper
claims.exact_statement: For N>=4,2<=r<=N/2 and delta=N|b|^2-1>0, white targets admit both testing errors <=eta with ceil(24e9 delta^(-2)((N-1)/(r-1))^2 log(1/eta)) fresh copies.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Common Pauli axes, random r-subset selected after preparation, all local outcomes used in exponential score; uniform heterogeneous-product-array null proof, then convexification.
claims.scientific_importance: Simpler finite protocol closes growing-r matching under a narrow target law.
missing_obligations: Practical constants; no claim that a binary-effect implementation attains the same cost; general concentration targets not covered.

claims.title: Acquired anchor and finite precision
claims.exact_statement: Separate calibration with a declared positive gap floor, clipped exactly rounded anchor and finite rational arithmetic yields sound verification for every ALLSEP input and target completeness at the charged calibration confidence.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Calibration copies are additional; common frame certificate optional and separately charged; detector bias/drifting individual frames not modelled. Exact formulae are in the frozen addendum. Calibration is 3K copies and 3Kr outcomes; integer rejection for exact sampling has finite expected random-bit cost, not deterministic worst-case bit bound.
claims.scientific_importance: Makes the upper executable and preserves supplied/acquired boundary.
missing_obligations: Practical metrology certificate acquisition and detector/error model; unknown-gap staging has only target-side high-probability resource bound, no universal deterministic cap or null termination.

claims.title: Matched narrow-class operational tradeoff
claims.exact_statement: For independent white-Schur polarized targets with a fixed positive delta floor and 2<=r=o(N), preparation complexity is Theta(N^2/r^2) for fixed error; saturated outcome cost m r and physical-qubit cost m N are charged.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: ALLSEP null has no Schur/Casimir promise; supplied anchor or separately charged calibration; static example has N|b|^2→8/pi.
claims.scientific_importance: Strong operational theorem, with explicit interface and matching lower/upper.
missing_obligations: A trusted Casimir promise changes the problem and permits one-body O(N) testing; no universal promised-null lower.

claims.title: Mean-only sublinear trace invisibility
claims.exact_statement: For PI qubit states with exact mean J^2=3N/4, common de Finetti gives half-trace<=min(1,6r/(N+1)+6sqrt((ln2)r/(N+1))), hence all r=o(N) invisibility.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Only mean Casimir, arbitrary PI states; CKMR common measure and finite marginal approximation.
claims.scientific_importance: Useful weaker boundary, not headline novelty.
missing_obligations: Does not give centered quadratic entropy or the sharp white coefficient.

claims.title: Mean-only quadratic entropy is false
claims.exact_statement: Even N: mix permutation-invariant spin-zero state with |0>^tensor N at weight 3/(N+2). Mean J^2=3N/4 but centered D=Omega(r/N) for log N<<r=o(N).
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Exact mean promise; rare macroscopic spin tail; reference is its own marginal product.
claims.scientific_importance: Decisive hypothesis falsifier; full tail law is necessary for the promoted theorem.

claims.title: Critical Gibbs local crossover
claims.exact_statement: For rho_N proportional to exp(2J^2/N), tau=I/2, each centered chi_P^2,D,half-trace tends to zero iff r=o(sqrt(N)); at nonzero critical r/sqrt(N), a bounded cosine measurement separates; above window half-trace→1.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Full tensor trace and beta=2 normalization; model/temperature/preparation are supplied or charged; r=1 exactly zero.
claims.scientific_importance: Concrete sharp physical application of a varying collective concentration scale.
missing_obligations: External/statistical-mechanics priority review; no ALLSEP entanglement implication.

claims.title: Critical quantitative regimes
claims.exact_statement: For 2<=r=o(sqrt(N)), chi_P^2~2[Gamma(5/4)/Gamma(3/4)]^2 r(r-1)/N, half-trace=Theta(r/sqrt(N)), D=Theta(r^2/N). For r/sqrt(N)→infinity, D=Theta(r/sqrt(N)), including r=N.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Uniform finite quartic/Stirling envelopes, odd-support cancellation, bounded heat witness, exact hypergeometric large-window law, global-to-local entropy via PI+SSA.
claims.scientific_importance: Quantitative strengthening beyond nonvanishing chi-square; fresh proof independently verifies leading chi but only logarithmic above-window KL lower.
missing_obligations: External specialist review and priority clearance; full crossover profile and sharp KL constant not proved.

claims.title: Polar harmonic-dimension upper
claims.exact_statement: Compact positive smooth link closure of total area 4pi and f(r)/r→a>0 in dr^2+f(r)^2H(log r) imply limsup h_k/k^2<=9a^2/4.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: No slow H_t or fixed pointwise area needed; Li-Wang energy-Gram trace inequality and uniform Weyl asymptotics.
claims.historical_priority: Routine corollary of published Li-Wang method; no standalone novelty claim
claims.scientific_importance: Corrects opportunity ranking and provides a matching class upper.
missing_obligations: No general sharp Ricci theorem claimed.

claims.title: Inherited lower plus class supremum
claims.exact_statement: For 4/9<v<1, the audited N175 single-metric lower families and G01 support class supremum 9v/4; each c<9v/4 has a complete smooth Ricci>=0 metric with AVR=v and limsup h_k/(k+1)^2>c.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Inherited one-metric countable construction; class membership checked; no endpoint attainment or all-degree/full-limit lower.

claims.scientific_importance: Meaningful source validation/composition, not a new upper discovery.
missing_obligations: External review of whole-ball compact-family continuation and countable matching; non-effective construction.

claims.title: Protected-branch maximal-correlation lemma
claims.exact_statement: If both players independently select two protected observation branches each of weight >=eta, with independent point blocks and input maximal correlation <=rho<1, sigma_out>=eta(1-rho)/2. For the exact ideal Lin figure law this gives sigma_AR>=sigma_input/9.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Exact independent selectors and disjoint/private point seed blocks; actual detyped CL sampler not identified with ideal figure.
claims.historical_priority: Likely standard operator-projection mechanism; exact priority UNKNOWN
claims.scientific_importance: Local soundness repair candidate, not full compression or repetition.
missing_obligations: Actual adjusted binary-seed law, detyped prefix registers and unrestricted-vs-synchronous issue.

claims.title: Noisy-parity acquired bank limits
claims.exact_statement: With supplied correct two-feature prefix and M bounded acquired suffix functions, rank-two margin kappa permits at most floor(lambda^2(M-kappa^2)/kappa^2) secrets per fixed bank; at kappa=lambda maximum is M-1. Efficient inverse-polynomial margin banks enable paid heavy-Fourier LPN extraction.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Raw-data acquisition, equally informed LPN comparator, prefix supplied; exact information/memory/sample bounds and exponential-compute positive learner in report.
claims.historical_priority: Classical mechanisms; exact statement priority UNKNOWN
claims.scientific_importance: Useful lower/resource diagnostics without demonstrated acquisition advantage.
missing_obligations: No KLS frontier advance; independent proof audit not done here.

claims.title: Matroid strict descent and cyclic socle
claims.exact_statement: Fano arbitrary-pair neighbors refute strict fixed-target deficit descent while plateau paths remain. Larson symmetric-exchange conjecture is already false; weaker arbitrary-quadratic formulation stays open. Cyclic socle calculation is covered by Oh stronger all-parameter theorem.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: Finite exact certificates and opened primary sources; no cancellation of auxiliary buffer units.
claims.historical_priority: Duplicate/negative; no new positive theorem promoted
claims.scientific_importance: Prevents false frontier claim and preserves exact failure.
missing_obligations: Weak quadratic White conjecture remains unresolved.

claims.title: Older decisive repair gates
claims.exact_statement: Missing older thermal source proofs, unsupported positive-characteristic group-ring inference, and actual compression wire/detyping law remain the three older decisive repair gates.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: New candidates cannot validate older claims by proximity; citations with narrower hypotheses are not all-field no-go theorems.
claims.scientific_importance: Keeps active programme from promoting unsupported foundations.
missing_obligations: Obtain exact old proof or withdraw old assertion; repair primary citation scope; expose actual final sampler.

claims.title: Critical mean/pair extrapolation is false
claims.exact_statement: For eta_N=(1-epsilon)omega_N+epsilon Pi_sym/(N+1), epsilon=mu_2/sqrt(N), the limiting critical pair coefficient and Casimir scale agree with the Gibbs target, but every local half trace<=epsilon→0, including r=N. At r=ceil(2log_2N), chi_P^2 diverges while trace and KL vanish.
claims.assumptions_and_interface: N sufficiently large that epsilon<=1; fully separable PI mixture, tau=I/2; omega_N is the full white state.
claims.historical_priority: UNKNOWN; presented as scoped falsifier, not frontier theorem
claims.scientific_importance: Shows the exact Gibbs-tail hypothesis and bounded measurement evidence cannot be replaced by mean/pair or chi-only data.
